tasks.spec:
You are revising v62 of the MK2 Optical Bland SMS pathway per two decisions Ankit made after reviewing the build. Work only in your current working directory. ./source is read-only reference: the CURRENT v62 lane artifacts (build_v62.py, v62_graph.json, scenarios.py, check_candidate_gate.py, redproof_run.py, report.md), plus v61_graph.json and SPEC-v62.md (the frozen spec, already updated with both revisions — read its items 6 and 7). Never modify ./source. No skills, MCP/Apps, network calls, or git commits.

START by copying every ./source artifact except v61_graph.json and SPEC-v62.md into your working directory root, then apply ONLY the two revisions below. Everything else stays byte-identical — this is a surgical pass, not a rebuild.

REVISION 1 — appointment search replaces the campaign flag. In build_v62.py, n_identity's responseData entry booked_already must map from `$.result.upcoming_appointment` (the gateway will answer: does this patient have a FUTURE appointment at this store, any booking channel) instead of `$.result.campaign_booked`. The route ["booked_already", "==", "true", -> e_defer] and its ordering before count==1 stay exactly as they are. Remove every other `campaign_booked` reference from the builder, graph, scenarios, gate, redproof, and report — the revised report should describe the appointment-search semantics (including: self-heals on cancellation, covers phone/walk-in bookings, send queue remains the first-line filter).

REVISION 2 — Chinese copy must match what the English produces, sentence for sentence, claiming nothing more. The current Chinese close in n_confirm.prompt says 您已预约成功 ("your booking succeeded") — that strengthens "You're all set." and must go. Produce a faithful rendering of: "You're all set. If you have further questions, please call MK2 Optical at (212) 219-2219" — an all-arranged statement (for example 您都安排好了。) followed by a faithful "if you have further questions, please call MK2 Optical at (212) 219-2219" sentence. Same for the PROPOSED Chinese deferral in report.md: a faithful rendering of "For that you'll have to contact the MK2 Optical office at (212) 219-2219" — keep the office sense with one consistent term, and do not add words like 门店 flourishes that change the meaning. In both: digits ASCII, brand exactly "MK2 Optical" in Latin script, phone (212) 219-2219 verbatim. Mark both renderings in report.md as final-proposed for Ankit's read.

AFTER EDITING: regenerate v62_graph.json by running `python3 build_v62.py` so the JSON matches the builder byte-for-byte; rerun `python3 check_candidate_gate.py v62_graph.json` (must pass), `python3 check_candidate_gate.py v61_graph.json` using a copy of source/v61_graph.json (must fail), and `python3 redproof_run.py` (must exit 0 printing mutations_caught=N, N >= 15). Record these executions in report.md. If the gate or redproof referenced campaign_booked anywhere, update those references to the new field while keeping every rule's strength unchanged.

HONESTY RULES: touch nothing outside the two revisions; if a byte-identical carry-over is impossible somewhere, flag it prominently in report.md rather than silently improvising.
tasks.verified: All Round B assertions still hold, plus: booked_already maps from $.result.upcoming_appointment, no campaign_booked reference survives, and the Chinese close drops the booking-succeeded phrasing while keeping MK2 Optical and the (212) number in both language closes.
